description.zh: AppId，从虚拟数字人开放平台的对应业务配置的开发者信息中获取的AppId
description.en: The AppId. Obtain this ID from the developer information in the service configuration on the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform.

description.zh: 后台绑定客户端包名信息后生成的license文件中的内容，可以从实例配置中去下载对应实例的license文件
description.en: The content of the license file. This file is generated after you attach the client package name. Download the license file for the instance from its configuration.

description.zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台的对应业务配置的开发者信息中获取的TenantId
description.en: The tenant ID. Obtain this ID from the developer information in the service configuration on the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform.
